name: presenter
description: Create and present Reveal.js slide decks with the native WordPress block editor.
author: Aaron D. Campbell

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:pkg-json && npm run format:check
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli -- wp plugin check presenter --mode=update --exclude-checks=file_type --exclude-directories=.git,.github,.phpunit.cache,assets-wp-repo,docs,local,node_modules,reveal.js,src,tests,tools,vendor
scripts.snapshot:wp:cli: cd tools/snapshot/env && wp-env run cli wp
scripts.test:core-blocks-runtime: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/headless/create-core-block-compatibility-fixture.php && node tools/headless/verify-core-block-compatibility.mjs
scripts.test:m6-runtime: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/headless/create-m6-runtime-fixture.php && node tools/headless/verify-m6-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:migration-dry-run: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/migration/create-dry-run-fixtures.php && node tools/migration/verify-dry-run-command.mjs && wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/migration/verify-dry-run-state.php
scripts.test:migration-apply: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/migration/create-apply-fixtures.php && node tools/migration/verify-apply-command.mjs
scripts.test:migration-prepare-status: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/migration/create-prepare-status-fixtures.php && node tools/migration/verify-prepare-status-command.mjs
scripts.test:migration-restore: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/migration/create-restore-fixtures.php && node tools/migration/verify-restore-command.mjs
scripts.test:migration-representation-runtime: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/headless/create-migration-representation-fixture.php && node tools/headless/verify-migration-representations.mjs
scripts.test:native-runtime: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/headless/create-native-deck-fixture.php && node tools/headless/verify-native-wordpress-deck.mjs
scripts.test:navigator-runtime: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/presenter/tools/headless/create-navigator-fixture.php && node tools/headless/verify-slide-navigator.mjs
